raw_text: Tracking the Agnipath protest escalation in real-time. OSINT monitoring detected coordinated rail blockade calls on Telegram since 5 AM — a full 6 hours before mainstream media coverage began. Multiple groups sharing police deployment locations and protest rally points simultaneously. The coordination pattern suggests organized mobilization rather than spontaneous protest.
